note: CaixaBank's Visa &Go is its revolving credit card: what's used is always repaid in monthly instalments, at 20.40% a year nominal (TIN; 22.42% TAE). Its maintenance fee of 36 euros a year isn't charged if the card is used at least once in the year, written as a waiver on any spending. CaixaBank's other credit cards are paid at the month's end, their rates applying only to purchases split into instalments. On 2026-10-30 the range was widened to the main banks: CaixaBank, Santander and BBVA, Spain's three largest banks. CaixaBank's credit cards page lists MyCard, the Visa Classic, the Visa Oro and the Visa &Go. MyCard (its page read 2026-10-30): 48 euros a year, waived for 3,000 euros of spending a year or a holder under 26 (the first year free is introductory; deferring purchases and the Día a Día programme, which the game doesn't track, aren't written); purchases paid at the month's end or split, the split at 20.40% a year nominal (TIN; 22.42% TAE), written as its rate; a cash advance on credit 4.50% with a floor of 4 euros. The Visa Oro: 95 euros a year, paid at the month's end in one sum by default (written in full; its page gives no rate for splitting). The Visa Classic's page states no yearly fee in figures and isn't written. Santander's Tarjeta Crédito (its page read 2026-10-30): no issue or maintenance fee; no fee on purchases in a currency other than the euro; paid in full at the month's start by default, or revolving at 18% a year nominal (TIN; 19.56% TAE, the bank's representative example), the least monthly payment 3% of the balance used, at least 25 euros. The Plan Santander Iberia Club (5 euros a month) is an optional plan on the same card and isn't written. BBVA's card pages answered 403 with 'Algo salió mal' and a reference ID (an Akamai block, not circumvented), and Banco Sabadell's site loads its pages by script with no card terms in what it serves, so neither is written. No minimum payment as a share of the balance is published for CaixaBank's Visa &Go and MyCard; tried: their card pages, CaixaBank's revolving card page (read 2026-10-30), which says the holder chooses the monthly instalment and the issuer sets a least one so that each instalment repays capital and interest and the debt is always cleared within five and a half years of its use, a term, not a share the game's form holds; Santander's figure is its own and isn't carried over.
